```{python}
from shapely.geometry import box
import geopandas as gpd
from funs import _pl_to_gpd, _gpd_to_pl

world_bbox = box(-180, -90, 180, 90)
world_box_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=[world_bbox], crs='EPSG:4326')
gdf = _pl_to_gpd(country_geo, geometry_col="geometry")
gdf['geometry'] = gdf['geometry'].make_valid()


world_landmass = gdf.dissolve()

# Extract the actual geometry object from the landmass
landmass_geom = world_landmass.geometry.iloc[0]
world_box_geom = world_box_gdf.geometry.iloc[0]

# Do the difference operation on the geometries directly
ocean_geom = world_box_geom.difference(landmass_geom)

# Wrap it in a GeoDataFrame
oceans_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=[ocean_geom], crs=world_box_gdf.crs)

#world_landmass = _gpd_to_pl(world_landmass)
#oceans_gdf = _gpd_to_pl(oceans_gdf)
#DSGeo.explore(oceans_gdf)
```

```{python}
city_gpd = _pl_to_gpd(city, geometry_col="geometry")

world_landmass_proj = world_landmass.to_crs('ESRI:54009')
cities_proj = city_gpd.to_crs('ESRI:54009')

cities_proj['distance_to_coast'] = cities_proj.geometry.distance(world_landmass_proj.geometry.iloc[0])
cities_proj
```

```{python}

    city_country
```

```{python}
    .group_by(c.iso)
    .agg(city = c.city.first())
```
